glossary.definition: Stored attention keys and values for processed tokens, so they aren't recomputed.
Processing the whole prompt before the first output token; limited by compute.
Generating output one token at a time; limited by memory bandwidth.
Time to first token: how long until the first output token appears.
Time per output token after the first; sets streaming speed.
A small, fast model that proposes tokens for a larger model to verify.
Share of drafted tokens the target model accepts in speculative decoding.
Abstract syntax tree: the structured parse of source code.
A compact list of a repository's files, classes and function signatures.
Language Server Protocol: editor tooling for definitions, references and symbols.
Directed acyclic graph: steps with one-way dependencies and no cycles.
The longest chain of dependent steps; it sets total latency.
Stored know-how, such as workflows and skills, that an agent can reuse.
A written target for how long a user-facing request may take, usually at p95, split into shares for each stage.
How long a wait feels to the user; early status lines and streamed words shorten it even when total time is unchanged.
One sequential model call on the path to an answer; each adds its own time to first token and generation time.
Adding and removing requests from the running batch at every decoding step.
Storing the KV cache in fixed-size pages so memory is not wasted and more sequences fit.
Stored attention keys and values for tokens already processed, reused at each new step.
An 8-bit floating-point format for weights and activations, supported on recent GPUs.
Activation-aware weight quantisation: a 4-bit weight-only method that protects the most important weights.
Representative prompts used to set quantisation scales.

symptomRouter.symptom: Coding agents read whole files to change a few lines
symptomRouter.advice: Navigate the syntax tree and load only the nodes that matter.
Let a small draft model propose tokens that the big model verifies in one pass.

symptomRouter.symptom: Time to first token is high with long, repeated prompts
symptomRouter.advice: Enable prefix caching and keep the prompt start stable.

symptomRouter.symptom: Long prompts stall other users’ streams at scale
symptomRouter.advice: Serve prefill and decode on separate GPU pools.

symptomRouter.symptom: Tool calls run one after another
symptomRouter.advice: Model the task as a graph and run independent steps in parallel.

symptomRouter.symptom: Users stare at a blank screen for seconds before the assistant answers
symptomRouter.advice: Set p95 budgets, trace each stage, stream a status line and tokens, run independent calls in parallel, cut LLM hops and time out slow tools with a fallback.

symptomRouter.symptom: Self-hosted model is slow and expensive, and requests queue at peak
symptomRouter.advice: Serve with a continuous-batching engine (vLLM, SGLang), load-test, and size GPUs for p95 at peak.

symptomRouter.symptom: A large open model needs too many GPUs to self-host
symptomRouter.advice: Quantise to FP8 (or 4-bit for one GPU), add an FP8 KV cache, and re-run your own evals.
